name: Last Layer Re-training
definition: A technique to instantly propagate a color edit from a single view to the entire NeRF by selectively retraining only the last layer of the color MLP, reducing parameters and preserving existing view-dependent information.
summary: Last Layer Re-training instantly propagates color edits to a NeRF by optimizing only the final MLP layer, preserving deeper view-dependent features while reducing computational cost.
